entities.name: NAS security parameters from E-UTRA
entities.description: A type 3 information element with length of 2 octets that provides the UE with information to create a mapped UMTS security context. It contains the 4 least significant bits of the downlink NAS COUNT value.

entities.name: DL NAS COUNT value (short)
entities.description: Contains the 4 least significant bits of the binary representation of the downlink NAS COUNT value applicable when this information element is sent. Located in octet 2, bits 1-4.

entities.name: Spare bits
entities.description: Bits 5-8 of octet 2 that are spare and shall be coded as zero.

entities.name: NAS security parameters from E-UTRA IEI
entities.description: Information element identifier for NAS security parameters from E-UTRA, located in octet 1, bits 8-5.

entities.name: Mapped UMTS security context creation
entities.description: Procedure where UE uses NAS security parameters from E-UTRA to create a mapped UMTS security context.

relations.description: The NAS security parameters from E-UTRA IE contains the DL NAS COUNT value (short) field.
The NAS security parameters from E-UTRA IE contains spare bits in octet 2.
The NAS security parameters from E-UTRA IE contains its information element identifier.
The NAS security parameters from E-UTRA IE enables the UE to create a mapped UMTS security context.
